# Newcastle Bathroom Renovations

Newcastle Bathroom Renovations (https://newcastlebathroomrenovations.com.au/) is a free referral and quote service for people who want bathroom renovation work in Newcastle, New South Wales, Australia. It does not renovate bathrooms itself. Enquiries from the quote form are passed to one local bathroom renovator who services the customer's area, and that business contacts the customer directly.

## Important facts
- No phone number is published on the site.
- The site does not publish its own prices, reviews or ranking claims. Cost guides cite named public sources.
- Rules pages summarise official NSW government and council sources, with links.
- Contact for enquiries and privacy requests: quotes@newcastlebathroomrenovations.com.au.
